meta.title: Create Text Driven Video
meta.summary: Generate a video from text, a reusable avatar, and a reusable voice.

hero.title: Create Text Driven Video
hero.summary: Generate a video from text, a reusable avatar, and a reusable voice.

endpoint_summary.summary: Generate an avatar video from text using a reusable avatar and voice.

auth_requirements.title: Auth Requirements
items: Authentication is required via Authorization header.

preconditions.title: Preconditions
items: Prepare avatar and voice assets before calling this endpoint.
Requires avatar_asset_id, voice_asset_id, and non-empty text.
Avatar and voice IDs can come from your Media Assets or official public assets.
Also accepts optional duration_seconds, links, clarity, aspect_ratio, and model.

fields.name: aspect_ratio
fields.description: Requested output aspect ratio, such as 16:9 or 9:16.

fields.name: avatar_asset_id
fields.description: Reusable avatar asset ID owned by the current user or listed as an official public asset.

fields.name: clarity
fields.description: Requested output resolution label, such as 1080P or 2K.

fields.name: links
fields.description: Optional reference links submitted from the Playground form.

fields.name: model
fields.description: Generation model label or version selected in the Playground form.

fields.name: voice_asset_id
fields.description: Reusable voice asset used for text-driven lip sync.

fields.name: code
fields.description:
Application response code.

| Code | Meaning |
| ---- | ------- |
| `0` | OK |
| `12` | Invalid input |
| `1401` | Insufficient credits |
| `1402` | Asset category does not match this operation |
| `1403` | Voice asset is required |
| `1404` | Provider returned an error |
| `1405` | Provider request timed out |
| `13` | Authentication is required |
| `16` | Rate limit exceeded |
| `99` | Server error |

examples.title: Examples
examples.request_example:
curl -X POST https://api.medux.io/api/app/v1/generate/video/text_driven \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $MEDUX_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"aspect_ratio":"ASPECT_RATIO","avatar_asset_id":"AVATAR_ASSET_ID","clarity":"CLARITY","duration_seconds":1,"links":["https://example.com/reference"],"model":"MODEL","model_id":"MODEL_ID","text":"Hello from Medux","title":"Demo title","voice_asset_id":"VOICE_ASSET_ID"}'
examples.curl_command:
curl -X POST https://api.medux.io/api/app/v1/generate/video/text_driven \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $MEDUX_API_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"aspect_ratio":"ASPECT_RATIO","avatar_asset_id":"AVATAR_ASSET_ID","clarity":"CLARITY","duration_seconds":1,"links":["https://example.com/reference"],"model":"MODEL","model_id":"MODEL_ID","text":"Hello from Medux","title":"Demo title","voice_asset_id":"VOICE_ASSET_ID"}'
